title: Application-send turn shadow policy contract
purpose: Define the first shadow-only contract for application_send_turn_planning without authorizing an alternate production planner, active selection, or reuse of receive-credit epochs.
scope: This specification covers bounded connection-local observations at the existing application-send actor-turn planning boundary, deterministic legacy_current or conservative shadow recommendations, immutable one-turn snapshots, bounded fallback reasons, axis-specific provenance, replay, and force-legacy rollback. It does not define a policy winner or an active planner algorithm.
context: The existing force seam and construction provenance deliberately distinguish legacy_current and conservative campaign identities while both retain the current legal scheduler. Retained rotation, adjacent-write accumulation, transition grouping, sender-queue, continuation-cursor, and fixed-quantum experiments remain negative. Shadow work therefore proves the observation, recommendation, provenance, and rollback architecture before any later evidence-backed planner proposal is reviewed.
open_questions: Which bounded observation subset is sufficiently complete for the first offline-reviewed non-neutral planner proposal?
What independent-host and workload coverage will be required before conservative can denote behavior distinct from the current legal planner?

requirements.title: Evaluate application-send turn shadow recommendations without changing applied behavior
requirements.statement: When application_send_turn_planning shadow mode is enabled, the runtime MUST capture a bounded immutable observation at the existing connection-actor send-turn planning boundary, deterministically recommend one value from the closed legacy_current and conservative set for exactly one actor turn, keep legacy_current as the applied policy, expose no recommendation consumer in the scheduler or protocol data plane, and preserve priority, same-stream ordering, congestion, pacing, anti-amplification, flow-control, packet, ownership, cancellation, disposal, recovery, lifecycle, queue, buffer, and terminal-state authority.
notes: The first rule may be semantic-neutral and may recommend conservative only as a distinct evidence identity; this requirement does not authorize a new planner implementation.
A later active or behavior-distinct policy requires a separate reviewed requirement and evidence package.

requirements.title: Retain versioned send-turn shadow fallback and provenance evidence
requirements.statement: The application_send_turn_planning shadow contract MUST version its observation, rule, snapshot, reason, and provenance records; handle missing, stale, saturated, contradictory, and out-of-domain observations with a deterministic conservative recommendation and bounded reason code; retain requested, recommended, applied, and forced identities without relabeling receive-credit evidence; support deterministic replay and an independently tested force-legacy rollback; and exclude scenario names, workload labels, payload constants, requested concurrency, peer identity, URLs, and application identity from runtime controller inputs.
notes: Excluded, invalid, negative, and unmatched rows remain append-only evidence with reason codes.
Machine learning remains offline-only; no runtime model file or self-updating threshold is authorized.
